name: Long-read de novo assembly benchmarking
description: Our benchmark concludes that there is no assembler that performs the best in all the evaluation categories. However, our results show that overall Flye is the best-performing assembler for PacBio CLR and ONT reads, both on real and simulated data. Meanwhile, best-performing PacBio HiFi assemblers are Hifiasm and LJA. Next, the benchmarking using longer reads shows that the increased read length improves assembly quality, but the extent to which that can be achieved depends on the size and complexity of the reference genome.
general_score_metric: multi-metric (NGA50 reported as primary size/contiguity metric alongside misassembly rate and genome fraction)
notes: Non‑LLM bioinformatics benchmark; results depend strongly on read type (ONT/CLR/HiFi), read length, genome complexity, assembler version and parameters; includes both simulated and real datasets; no single assembler dominates all metrics.
